system.description: (●●) Standing over bodies of water causes your magic to seep away in proportion to the volume and speed at which it is flowing. In game terms you take a penalty to your Arete: around 1 for a small stream, heavy rain or sewers, 2 for a small sedate river, torrential rain or deep lake, 4 for a major rushing river or deep ocean and 5 for Niagara Falls. If this penalty reduces your Arete to 0 or below you may not cast and any ongoing spells you are maintaining end.
